reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music system in Provincia! No more abrupt transitions between day, night, title, and combat music. Our new self-crossfade technique ensures a smooth listening experience, enhancing your time in the colony. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
